name: Stormwind Vault
_map: Map 35 is 'StormwindPrison' in both clients: the Stormwind Vault map Blizzard left unused (a WMO-only map). Turtle made it a 5-player dungeon (level 58+) without changing its files; 3.3.5 has the same map as a non-instance map, so the module replaces its Map row with an instance row (existing_map).
_ship_assets: Nothing to ship but the world map art (world_map): the map's WMO and the dungeon loading screen are 3.3.5's own.

instance._loading_screen: Turtle uses the generic dungeon loading screen (LoadingScreens 23).
instance._areatriggers: Turtle's entrances: 107 and 5002 in Stormwind, 5003 at Mirror Lake (Elwynn); 109 the exit inside (to Stormwind).
instance._graveyard: Turtle's graveyard for the Vault: WorldSafeLocs 41 (Northshire / Elwynn, Alliance; 111 for the Horde is further away), {map,x,y,z,o}.
